visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young couple standing outdoors on an asphalt road dressed in black graduation gowns with vibrant green V-neck trims; the man has short black hair and a lean build, while the woman holds a large white Hello Kitty balloon and a brown paper bag, smiling brightly as she poses. (2) A transition shows an Instagram profile screen from 2016 with photos of the couple; the woman is shown with a small green plant resting on her head making a cute expression, followed by a photo of the man smiling in a dimly lit bedroom environment. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a light wooden table where two pairs of hands are seen folding blue NT$1000 banknotes and placing them into a clear glass jar containing several other bills and a decorative green moss ball. (4) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the couple in various urban settings: using an ATM, walking through a modern transit corridor with white walls, and the woman playfully running through a brightly lit shopping mall wearing a denim jacket and glasses. (5) In a home living room with a beige sofa and a black patterned pillow, the couple sits together holding the glass jar of money; they both make exaggerated expressions of surprise and curiosity, staring intently at the jar held between them. (6) The focus shifts to a screen recording of the 'Richart' banking app on a smartphone being held by the woman; the interface displays various financial tools like 'Investment', 'Loan', and 'Insurance' against a clean white and grey background layout. (7) Footage displays the couple on a ski lift at a snow-covered mountain resort in Japan, wearing helmets and orange goggles; later, the woman sits at a restaurant table presented with multiple pizzas and flatbreads, gesturing excitedly with her hands. (8) In a well-lit home office, the couple is shown working at desks with dual monitors; the man stands up to take a photo of the woman with his smartphone while she poses with a snack, creating a dynamic and busy atmosphere. (9) The couple is seen walking away from the camera through a lush outdoor garden area with tall bamboo trees; finally, they are back in their living room bowing deeply toward the camera before the man shows the woman a calculation on his phone.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們交往10年. (2) [Variety]: 2016年. [Logo]: @changhao_o. (3) [Subtitle]: 第二年就開始養成... 每個月一人NT1,000元. 一起放到小罐子. 成為最甜蜜的儀式感. 就這樣一路存到畢業. 然後一起出社會. (4) [Subtitle]: 後來發現小罐子浪漫, 但裡面的錢只會變小. 於是就有了. 第一個共同帳戶. (5) [Slogan]: 台新Richart數位帳戶. (6) [Subtitle]: 它是最多人使用的數位銀行. 在家就能搞定開戶與許多金融服務. 不管繳費、轉帳、投資, 甚至買保險, 全都在APP裡一次完成. (7) [Subtitle]: 還能享有優利率活儲. 只要完成任務四選一. 優利子帳戶存NT30萬元. 就有1.8%年利率. (8) [Subtitle]: 像我們很喜歡去日本旅遊. 完成任務二超輕鬆. 偶爾看到日圓變便宜就在Richart App買一點. 邊存外幣邊領優利子帳戶, 超優活儲利息. (9) [Subtitle]: 生活和旅遊都因為Richart變得更從容、有目標. 一直到現在. Richart依舊是我們愛的小罐子. (10) [Subtitle]: 一直以來的陪伴, 讓我們在忙碌中也能穩穩存錢, 實現一些小目標. 每年生出好幾千塊的利息. 能夠多吃幾頓大餐. 多幾趟小旅行. (11) [Subtitle]: 來慰勞我們一整年的辛勞. 2026的目標. 繼續陪伴我們啦. (12) [Subtitle]: 請多多指教~ (摸). (13) [Subtitle]: 好消息. [Slogan]: Richart新朋友. 3.5%年利率. (14) [Subtitle]: 把錢存進去. 就享NT10萬元內最高3.5%優利. 完成任務還能拿最高200元喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 身邊很多朋友加辦台新Richart卡. 四大超商和11萬家通路. 消費回饋最高3.8%耶. (16) [Subtitle]: 卡跟帳戶可以一起辦起來. (17) [Subtitle]: 如果刷一片尿布10塊錢的話. 可以... 哇!!! 哇塞!! 可以多買好幾百片耶. 欸老婆~~ Richart真的是...

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody starts the track, providing a warm and upbeat foundation; a clear, friendly male voice begins narrating the couple's history with a high degree of pitch variability and clear articulation. (2) As the visuals depict money being placed into a jar, a subtle rustling sound of paper is heard, perfectly layered with the ongoing guitar music; the speaker's tone remains cheerful and engaging throughout this storytelling phase. (3) A sequence of soft 'whoosh' sound effects accompanies each visual cut during the travel montage, adding a sense of movement; the background music remains constant in volume and tempo, keeping the energy level high. (4) The audio transitions to include digital sound effects such as 'dings' and 'pops' as the banking app features are highlighted; these sound effects are crisp and distinct, punctuating the narration which now focuses on financial benefits. (5) A female voice enters with high energy and a bright tone, discussing travel experiences; her speech rate is slightly faster, reflecting excitement, and it overlaps seamlessly with the pop-inflected acoustic BGM. (6) Cartoonish sound effects like a playful 'boing' are used during a humorous visual scene, while the male narrator continues to explain reward details; the spectral brightness of the track is high, emphasizing the high-frequency dings and vocal clarity. (7) The final phase features both voices laughing and shouting 'Wow!' with high arousal; the music reaches a slight crescendo before ending with a clean hard cut that leaves a professional and polished acoustic impression.
